unsupported_claims: The data show 'no detectable advantage for any' of the three methods on brain MRI, although significance results are supplied only for MedNeXt-Lite versus nnU-Net.
X.trap_note: It reports the small brain MRI difference and its confidence interval spanning zero without claiming significant improvement.

Y.trap_note: It accurately reports that the brain MRI comparison does not establish an improvement.

q1_reason: Y clearly presents the significant gains and parameter reduction while explicitly distinguishing untested comparisons, whereas X extends a statistical conclusion to all three methods.
